From 95bf25bb9ed5dedb7fb39f76489f7d6843ab0475 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org>
Date: Tue, 27 Feb 2024 14:19:29 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/udl: Add ARGB8888 as a format

Even though the UDL driver converts to RGB565 internally (see
pixel32_to_be16() in udl_transfer.c), it advertises XRGB8888 for
compatibility. Let's add ARGB8888 to that list.

This makes UDL devices work on ChromeOS again after commit
c91acda3a380 ("drm/gem: Check for valid formats"). Prior to that
commit things were "working" because we'd silently treat the ARGB8888
that ChromeOS wanted as XRGB8888.

Fixes: c91acda3a380 ("drm/gem: Check for valid formats")
Reviewed-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240227141928.1.I24ac8d51544e4624b7e9d438d95880c4283e611b@changeid

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/udl/udl_modeset.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/udl/udl_modeset.c
index 7702359c90c2..0f8d3678770e 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/udl/udl_modeset.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/udl/udl_modeset.c
@@ -253,6 +253,7 @@ static int udl_handle_damage(struct drm_framebuffer *fb,
 static const uint32_t udl_primary_plane_formats[] = {
 	DRM_FORMAT_RGB565,
 	DRM_FORMAT_XRGB8888,
+	DRM_FORMAT_ARGB8888,
 };
 
 static const uint64_t udl_primary_plane_fmtmods[] = {
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/udl/udl_modeset.c`**
   - A new format, `DRM_FORMAT_ARGB8888`, has been added to the `udl_primary_plane_formats` array. This change allows the UDL driver to advertise support for the ARGB8888 pixel format in addition to the existing formats (RGB565 and XRGB8888).

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The addition of the ARGB8888 format is a response to a previous commit (c91acda3a380) that changed how valid formats are checked in the DRM subsystem. The patch addresses a compatibility issue that arose in ChromeOS, where the UDL driver needed to support ARGB8888 to function correctly. By including this format, the UDL driver can now properly handle requests for ARGB8888, ensuring that devices using this format work as intended on ChromeOS.

drm/udl: Add ARGB8888 as a format

Even though the UDL driver converts to RGB565 internally (see
pixel32_to_be16() in udl_transfer.c), it advertises XRGB8888 for
compatibility. Let's add ARGB8888 to that list.

This makes UDL devices work on ChromeOS again after commit
c91acda3a380 ("drm/gem: Check for valid formats"). Prior to that
commit things were "working" because we'd silently treat the ARGB8888
that ChromeOS wanted as XRGB8888.

Fixes: c91acda3a380 ("drm/gem: Check for valid formats")
Reviewed-by: Dmitry Baryshkov <dmitry.baryshkov@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Douglas Anderson <dianders@chromium.org>

The UDL driver was not advertising the ARGB8888 format, which led to compatibility issues on ChromeOS after a change in the DRM subsystem that enforced valid format checks. This caused the driver to fail to handle ARGB8888 requests correctly, as it was only advertising XRGB8888, resulting in malfunctioning UDL devices.
